features.title: Four hooks: session-start, stop gate, format-on-edit, git guard
features.user_visible_behavior: In a project with harness.json, a session opens with the Operating Loop and current state injected; stopping with an invalid feature list is blocked; edits are formatted; destructive git is denied everywhere.
verification: echo '{}' | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=<dir without harness.json> node hooks/session-start.mjs prints nothing and exits 0
evidence: 2026-09-06: session-start.mjs against D:/Project/yakusub (no harness.json yet) → empty stdout, exit 0

features.title: scaffold.mjs writes the Scaffold from templates without overwriting
features.user_visible_behavior: /harness:init on a Node/Python/Rust/Go project detects commands, writes harness.json, init.sh, feature_list.json, progress log, docs/harness/*, appends a CLAUDE.md block, and generates .agent/context.md; a second run changes nothing.
verification: node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs" passes scaffold.test.mjs (fresh write, idempotence, CLAUDE.md block append/stale/refresh, hand-written .agent/context.md preserved, init.sh runs verify, version gate fails on a missing tool)

features.title: validate.mjs scores five subsystems and reports drift
features.user_visible_behavior: /harness:audit prints a 0–100 score across instructions/state/verification/scope/lifecycle, FAIL/WARN/INFO findings, and template drift; exits 1 on any FAIL.
verification: scaffold.test.mjs: a fresh scaffold scores >= 70; a passing feature without evidence makes it exit 1
evidence: 2026-09-06: node --test → validate tests pass; npm run verify → see claude-progress.md Session 001

features.title: install.ps1 / install.sh install the Profile and register the marketplace
features.user_visible_behavior: Running the installer copies profile/CLAUDE.md to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (backing up a foreign file), merges marketplace jiranon + enabledPlugins.harness@jiranon into ~/.claude/settings.json without touching other keys, and prints next steps.
verification: .\install.ps1 on this machine; then ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md contains the Profile and settings.json contains extraKnownMarketplaces.jiranon and enabledPlugins.harness@jiranon while keeping the mattpocock marketplace
Claude Code lists harness@jiranon after restart / plugin install
features.notes: Installer written and parse-checked; not yet run on this machine.

features.title: yakusub migrated to the plugin Runtime
features.user_visible_behavior: yakusub has harness.json; its project-level stop-gate and biome hooks and .claude/settings.json hooks are removed in favour of the plugin; CLAUDE.md no longer carries the Operating Loop; ./init.sh and the stop gate are green.

features.title: agent-skills reads harness.json directly (retire generated .agent/context.md)
features.user_visible_behavior: Skills in Jiranon-K/agent-skills read commands and paths from harness.json when present, so /harness:init no longer needs to generate .agent/context.md.
verification: /setup-context in a harness project reports harness.json as the source and writes nothing
features.notes: Follow-up recorded in ADR-0003. Requires changes in the agent-skills repository.

features.title: Evaluator rubric tuned against human review
features.user_visible_behavior: After 3–5 tuning rounds on real yakusub features, harness-evaluator's Accept/Revise/Block matches the user's own judgment; each round is logged in the project rubric's tuning log.
verification: docs/harness/evaluator-rubric.md in yakusub has >= 3 tuning-log rows and the last two rounds show no disagreement
